commands.bsc.readiness.start: fixed native read-only binary; lifecycle lock; durable UUID receipt; snapshot hash identity
commands.bsc.readiness.stop: SIGTERM current managed job only; no force kill
commands.bsc.candidate.select: offline G0.7 A/B candidate request only: fixed SELF_A|SELF_B resource, profile_version generation CAS, native g07_candidate request record; effective only after the native apply at the desktop bsc sync; never arm, sign or send
commands.bsc.source.mode.set: source mode request only: fixed BSC_INGRESS_* source and OFF|SHADOW|LIVE as `<SOURCE_ID>:<MODE>` resource, config_version generation CAS, applied or refused by the native bsc_runtime source owner with a durable receipt; a requested LIVE stays effective BLOCKED (ECONOMIC_LIVE_NOT_AUTHORIZED); never arm, sign or send

missing: Readiness head block not provided by native record
source_snapshot: SHA-256 manifest of every staged file; Data as of is explicit sync time; operational result keeps its canonical relative path and source snapshot hash
command_cas: BSC resource_id is the observed launch UUID, rechecked under lifecycle lock. A new launch invalidates stale start/stop requests.

command_bindings.gate: READ_ONLY; no signing; launch UUID CAS; durable receipt; session/CSRF

native_bindings_rules: Each census field resolves to exactly one rule: an explicit field list beats the longest matching prefix, which beats '*'. Rows inside a section keep the native schema order. EXCLUDED needs panel none.

native_bindings.reason: deployment/portal identity of the snapshot
provider id only, never a URL
repo-relative paths only; absolute local paths are masked by safe_text
BSC-048: typed provenance of a GUI readiness result, the sync's import gate; internal metadata, the result itself is shown from its readiness record
superseded acceptance contract; V5 is the only active authority (historical bytes stay evidence, never shown as authority)
state_dir only as redacted status, never a local path (G7)
candidate salt: SECRET_NEVER_BROWSER
embedded copy of the bound preflight; shown from its own record and bound via evidence_inputs.preflight_sha256

native_bindings.wire: GateStatus(G0.8).reason_codes CHAIN_* / EVIDENCE_* and NativeRecord · bsc.monitoring.state
native_bindings.reason: BSC-011: chain outcome and evidence integrity next to the overall verdict
external error text; deliberately filtered by the projection
V2 §2.3: the UNRESOLVED G0.8 record is the acquisition verdict's own section

native_bindings.wire: history/report query (F4), not a STATE frame
native_bindings.reason: per-block/transaction/receipt rows
raw calldata: BINARY_EXCLUDED
raw log data: BINARY_EXCLUDED
raw salt: SECRET_NEVER_BROWSER (A frozen salt included; B never)
private B economics record; field-level audit before any exposure, at most salt_commitment and identity (G12)
G9
G8 R0; chain/archive source only as provider id
G21 DRY5/DRY6 checks
D2/D3 PREPARE handoff
order V2 §5: requested/effective modes of the five sources from their native owner
per-request receipt of the source owner; its one-line form is the gateway command receipt
C1 read-only runtime: per-source health and counters, journal, mode READ_ONLY

canonical chain follower: head, header fetch lag, reorgs, skipped blocks, canonical Flap/Four launches (C1 scope) joined with pending sightings against the block time (G0.4 denominator); C2 resume backfill counted apart
C2 chain-state owner (BSC_STATE_C2 SHADOW): coherence, retained window, held candidates/uncertain, per-sender confidence, canonical/pending effects, conflicts, overflow, checkpoint restore

C3 PAPER path (BSC_EXEC SHADOW): lifecycle state (identity, probe, decode-only/drift, nonce, lanes), launches, PAPER sink handoffs, refusals per stage, local T_ingress→T_shadow_sink latency (not T_send)

Phase H Strategy C (BSC_STRATEGY_C SHADOW): decisions by verdict, PAPER entries/cancels/exits by reason, gains/losses after every cost, unresolved positions, configured limits; GAS_EVIDENCE_REFUSED with its reason

G0.4 census replayed from the runtime journals: windows (COMPLETE/UNTERMINATED), denominator, C1 scope, classes against the block time, coverage gaps, unjoined, outages, clock check; no verdict before confirmed criteria

G0.4 verdict of the finished campaign against the versioned criteria (bsc_runtime g04-verdict, order V2 §8): criteria SHA-256 and state, CRITERIA_UNCONFIRMED (no venue rated) until the user confirmed them, then per venue denominator, actionable share, lead and CONTINUE/ADAPT/STOP/NOT_EVALUABLE
lead of the first verified full sighting before the block time (local wall-clock estimate vs. header ms; fetch lag bounds the clock offset)
external buys after the launch in its block (observable competition)
C1.9 local native latency (BSC-023): boundaries T_ingress→L2 and egress→handoff, one clock, n/p50/p95/p99/max; not acquisition, not the Linux C3 target
C1.6 host provenance of the measurement: topology, fingerprint, profile hint/selection, QoS
C1.9 consumer integrity: HOT0 counters and the hashes binding the raw tables
C1.9b hook-path report (Chapel testnet only); none before a controlled testnet run
raw C1.9b inputs; bound by hash into the hook-path report shown in Analytics §3
C1.10 freeze inputs/record (copy in bsc/native/evidence/c1/c1-10-freeze-*); verified by c1_freeze --verify at their darkbot_commit, not a GUI state
switchable runtime components of the same native owner (C2 state): requested/effective, LIVE BLOCKED until G0.8 PASS and evaluated G0.4

Phase F capture→replay identity of the newest finished runtime run (bsc_runtime replay-proof): manifest match, re-decoded sightings by venue, other pending sightings, census determinism, runtime launch counter; PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL
Phase F capacity preflight of a scoped capture (bsc_runtime capture-preflight): measured rates, writer throughput, free disk, verdict QUALIFIED/BLOCKED with the blocking resource
the run manifest stays next to its segments; its health reaches Monitoring through runtime-status capture[] and the replay proof
release-harness evidence (bsc/native/evidence/f), read by the reviewer; not a runtime record

Phase F quality verdict of the newest finished run (bsc_runtime capture-quality): CLEAN/NOT_CLEAN with the §11 reasons (losses, damage, canonical uncertainty, clock, decoder ambiguity, replay) and the §13 acceptance (native geth source connected without interruption through the capture window for the planned duration; no launch during an outage)

Phase G economics snapshot (Economics gate §15, g_economics_snapshot): model version, every bound source and evidence file by SHA-256, PRICED/COSTED/UNSUPPORTED per venue, version and path with its rule or reason, the policies; replay binds to its hash
Phase G local quote latency (§16, g_quote_latency, release build) over the real Portal parity states, bound to the economics snapshot: n/p50/p95/p99/max per quote stage; the quote alone, not T_send

Phase H replay of the newest finished run through Strategy C (bsc_runtime strategy-replay): journaled vs. reproduced outputs, first difference, config match, PASS/DIFFERS/INCOMPLETE/NOT_RUN, and the replay's PAPER result; v3 (Phase I, PHASENPLAN §17 J input): each entry's position against the foreign BUYs of its token (earliest block after the decision by header time, foreign BUYs ahead and in that block, gap to the first); not a proven outcome, nothing sent
